work.description: DCLXV: complete Romanorum pontificum body, personal/prelatical honors, detailed ceremonial conditions and prohibitions, benediction and datum LF4918–4922. The apparent §3 and §4 numbering/OCR is retained. Marginal labels LF4688–4692,4845–4846,4858–4871 belong to this witness. XML leaves41–43 show ordinary right-to-next-left continuation; no lost subscriptions. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
